The name Pem carries the meaning “Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Pem usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
